comment: A tenth input, a CV for the sync-mode switch, is kept in the enum for patch compatibility (Excavi.cpp:67) but its configInput and its jack are both commented out (Excavi.cpp:135, :651), so no click can reach it and it gets no line. The shape parameter reads out as a named wave or a percentage between two of them, and above 3 as a pulse width from 50 per cent down to 2 per cent (Excavi.cpp:25 to :49). Age sets the same two high-pass corners as the Axe module, 30Hz plus 9Hz a year and 0.5Hz plus 4Hz a year, with a make-up gain of 1 plus a tenth a year (Excavi.cpp:478, :479, :472). The drift is two sine waves per oscillator at rates chosen from primes over 100 so the pattern does not repeat audibly (Excavi.cpp:417 to :430). Output scaling is 5 for each solo output and for the ring modulation, and 2.5 for the sum (Excavi.cpp:558 to :561).
